title: PocketSpice
summary: Pocket NGSPICE circuit & power-electronics simulator with 320x170 scope
description: Full-flexibility NGSPICE (.tran/.ac/.dc/.op) circuit and power-electronics simulator for CardputerZero. Includes a 5-level switched-capacitor inverter (IEEE TPEL 2026), Buck/Boost converters, in-app netlist editor, bilingual user/AI manuals, ZClaw workspace auto-discovery, and 512MB RAM guardrails.
